questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a formal academic context?
options: Only when the conditions are met should the experiment be conducted.
The experiment should be conducted when the conditions are met.
If the conditions are met, the experiment should be conducted.
Conducting the experiment is only appropriate when the conditions are met.
questions.answer: Only when the conditions are met should the experiment be conducted.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to highlight the subject of the original sentence?
options: It was discovered that the breakthrough came from studying ancient texts.
The breakthrough came from studying ancient texts, it was surprising.
What was surprising was the breakthrough came from studying ancient texts.
The subject of the breakthrough was ancient texts, which were studied.
questions.answer: It was discovered that the breakthrough came from studying ancient texts.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional with a nuanced subjunctive structure to express regret about past actions?
options: If I had known about the risks, I would have taken more precautions.
If I had taken more precautions, I would have known about the risks.
Had I known about the risks, I would have taken more precautions.
I would have taken more precautions if the risks had been known to me.
questions.answer: If I had known about the risks, I would have taken more precautions.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to maintain coherence in a formal report?
options: The study found that participants performed better under these conditions. The results were statistically significant.
The study found that participants performed better under these conditions; the results were statistically significant.
The study found participants performed better under these conditions. The results were statistically significant.
The study found participants performed better under these conditions—results were statistically significant.
questions.answer: The study found that participants performed better under these conditions. The results were statistically significant.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of a formal register with a passive construction and a subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario?
options: It is important that the data should be analysed correctly to ensure accuracy.
It is important that the data be analysed correctly to ensure accuracy.
It is important the data be analysed correctly to ensure accuracy.
It is important that the data should be analysed correctly, ensuring accuracy.
questions.answer: It is important that the data be analysed correctly to ensure accuracy.
